Autoimmune destruction of endocrine pancreatic beta cells causes insulin deficiency; retinopathy, nephropathy and neuropathy are separately coded complications.
Mycoplasma-associated infectious encephalitis directly affects the brain; antecedent respiratory infections are separate illnesses.
